delivered.helperIntegrity: scripts/build-main.mjs hashes native/*.ps1 (SHA-256), writes dist-electron/native-manifest.json and embeds it in the main bundle as __NATIVE_MANIFEST__. NativeRunner re-hashes the requested script plus common.ps1 before every spawn; mismatch, unreadable or unlisted file throws NativeError kind 'integrity' and PowerShell is never started. main.ts calls configureNativeIntegrity before createBackend with required = app.isPackaged (packaged builds fail closed without a manifest). No edit to backend.ts was needed: the runner reads the process-wide config.
delivered.trustedConfirm: Verified already wired in main.ts: createTrustedConfirm over dialog.showMessageBox (Cancel default, full detail, requires visible/focused/trusted window), auto-approve only when TEST_MODE, which requires JARVIS_TEST_MODE plus a userData folder with a fixture prefix directly in the OS temp dir. Covered by a static wiring test.
delivered.fileAndDevUrlConfinement: main.ts uses isTrustedUrl/isAllowedRequestUrl/parseDevOrigin (ipcCore). Added: app-wide web-contents-created guards (window.open deny, will-navigate, webview block) and session will-download cancel.
delivered.legacyUserDataFix: resolveUserDataDir: the legacy 'Jarvis Desktop' folder is adopted only when userData is still Electron's default. Previously local-ai-smoke.cjs (temp userData, no test mode) would have been redirected to the real profile and saved settings there; it now runs in test mode in a desktop-companion-test-* temp folder and deletes it afterwards.
delivered.tray_startup_hotkey: registerHotkey tries CommandOrControl+Alt+J then CommandOrControl+Alt+Shift+J, validates accelerators (modifier + key only), reports conflicts into Activity, debounced 300 ms against key auto-repeat. applyLoginItem (packaged Windows only, --hidden arg, verifies the result) is implemented and tested but NOT called: no setting exists yet, and the app must not change OS startup without an explicit user choice.
delivered.reminders: enabled() preference hook (off marks tasks announced silently), burst cap MAX_BURST=4 with a '<n> more tasks are due' summary, resync() on powerMonitor 'resume' so reminders slipped by sleep are announced, notification body capped at 240 chars.
delivered.crashSafeLifecycle: LaunchGuard tolerates garbage counters and unwritable profiles (trackingError) and end() never throws; endSync() runs on window 'session-end' (logoff/shutdown) so a clean OS shutdown is not counted as a crash; 'unresponsive' and uncaughtException/unhandledRejection are recorded as Activity 'recovery' with user paths redacted; existing 5 s bounded backup on quit retained.
delivered.idleBehavior: IdleGovernor: one unref'd timer starts when the window hides/minimizes (5 min), clears the session cache once, cancelled on show; no polling. summarizeMetrics (pure) turns app.getAppMetrics into process count / working set / CPU for acceptance M5; smoke prints it, dev builds log it on idle.

limitations: Electron binary is not installed (ignore-scripts), so scripts/smoke.cjs and scripts/local-ai-smoke.cjs were syntax-checked only and NOT run; main.ts changes are covered by typecheck, bundling and static wiring tests, not an Electron run. Captain should run `npx electron scripts/smoke.cjs` where the binary exists.

Integrity is tamper-evidence, not authentication: the manifest ships in the same install, so an attacker able to rewrite the whole bundle can rewrite it. A file swapped between hash and PowerShell start (TOCTOU) is not prevented. -ExecutionPolicy Bypass is unchanged. Authenticode signing is an unavailable gate; no signature is invented.
No launch-at-login, notification or hotkey preference exists in Settings (contract not owned here), so those are not user-configurable. Needs Settings fields plus an IPC path owned by the API owner.
Reminders announced within the 10-minute start grace can repeat once after an app restart (fired-set is in memory).
uncaughtException handler records and keeps running instead of showing Electron's default error dialog.

Not touched (not owned or unavailable): signed updates, ARM64 tiers, commercial licensing, managed deployment (roadmap 117-120) remain gated; installer/uninstaller (111) and offline bundle (112) need the captain's package build; safeStorage migration for DPAPI (NSR-13) is a secrets.ts change owned elsewhere.
Real helper behaviour (focus/type/click, PowerShell speech) was not run: no real desktop input by policy.
